payload.title: Wallace Onboarding Architecture
payload.summary:
Decisions:
- Ada owns Wallace onboarding until the Discord handoff is stable.
- Wallace onboarding should publish approved customer-facing notes to Notion.

Action items:
- Ben: Prepare the Discord onboarding checklist by 2026-05-30.
- Ada: Review the Wallace routing rule.

payload.title: Notion Wiki Publishing
payload.summary:
Decisions:
- Notion is the durable wiki surface for approved meeting notes.
- Discord should receive concise announcements with links back to Notion.

Action items:
- Mira: Verify Notion database properties before sandbox launch.
- Perry: Keep private notes out of Discord announcements.
